mapper.insert: INSERT INTO pet ( pet_idx, mem_idx, pet_name, is_primary, pet_species, pet_gender, pet_breed, pet_age, pet_bday ) VALUES ( SEQ_PET_IDX.nextval, #{mem_idx}, #{pet_name}, #{is_primary}, #{pet_species}, #{pet_gender}, #{pet_breed}, #{pet_age}, #{pet_bday} )
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM pet WHERE mem_idx = #{mem_idx} ORDER BY is_primary DESC, pet_idx ASC
mapper.update: UPDATE pet SET pet_name = #{pet_name, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, pet_gender = #{pet_gender, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, pet_breed = #{pet_breed, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, pet_bday = TO_DATE(#{pet_bday, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, 'YYYY-MM-DD'), is_primary = #{is_primary, jdbcType=VARCHAR} WHERE pet_idx = #{pet_idx}
